arguments:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, select, subprocess, time
command="/home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime/bin/rea-mcp"
assert os.path.isfile(command) and os.access(command,os.X_OK)
p=subprocess.Popen([command],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
pending=bytearray()
def rpc(message, ident):
    p.stdin.write((json.dumps(message,separators=(",",":"))+"\n").encode())
    p.stdin.flush()
    deadline=time.monotonic()+90
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        while b"\n" in pending:
            raw,_,rest=pending.partition(b"\n")
            pending[:]=rest
            if not raw.strip(): continue
            msg=json.loads(raw)
            if msg.get("id")==ident:
                assert "error" not in msg, msg.get("error")
                return msg.get("result")
        ready,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],1)
        if ready:
            chunk=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),65536)
            if not chunk: raise RuntimeError("REA MCP closed stdout")
            pending.extend(chunk)
    raise TimeoutError("REA MCP response timeout for "+str(ident))
try:
    init=rpc({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"rea-portability-proof","version":"1.0"}}},1)
    p.stdin.write(b'{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}\n')
    p.stdin.flush()
    tools=rpc({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}},2)
    count=len(tools.get("tools",[]))
    assert count>=200, count
    res=rpc({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"inspect_analysis_settings","arguments":{}}},3)
    assert res.get("isError") is not True, res.get("content")
    print("REA_DIRECT_LOCAL_MCP=pass")
    print("REA_DIRECT_TOOLS="+str(count))
    print("REA_DIRECT_CALL=pass")
finally:
    p.terminate()
    try: p.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill();p.wait()
PY
